issues.title: Device registry has placeholder entries
issues.description: device-registry.json contains two example entries (dev-001, dev-002). Real device data must be entered after initial network scan and onboarding.
issues.resolution: Run the onboard-device workflow (navig ask "run the onboard-device workflow") for each real host, then remove example entries.

issues.title: Network subnet not confirmed
issues.description: space-context.json has default subnet 192.168.1.0/24. This must be updated to match the actual LAN range before network-scan and port-audit skills will produce accurate results.
issues.resolution: Edit .navig/memory/space-context.json and update primary_network.subnet, gateway, and dns fields.
